Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: BlueSigma onboarding — invoice-only ask for initial pilot

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to start the 6-week pilot. Before we kick off, a quick ask on our side: BlueSigma is an early-stage company and our procurement system does not issue purchase orders for short trials. Would Redwood consider a temporary invoice-only path for the pilot (invoices paid within net 30)? The pilot will be ~USD 3,200 total.

We can provide a W-9, COI (general liability), and a formal signed pilot statement of work. If there are any sales or legal forms we need to sign to limit liability during the pilot, please point us to them.

Wanted to get this on your radar so we can scope dates.

Attachments: Proposed_Invoice_Jan-26.pdf (PDF, 34KB)

Best,
Elena
Head of Partnerships
BlueSigma Analytics
(elena.rossi@bluesigma.ai)

Subject: Re: BlueSigma onboarding — invoice-only ask for initial pilot

Elena — thanks for the clear note and the invoice stub. Conversation follows internally but quick answers up-front: Redwood's standard onboarding requires a purchase order for contracted services. However, we do have a temporary invoice-only allowance for pilot engagements under $5k provided certain evidence is supplied and approvals are recorded.

To move forward quickly please send:
- Completed W-9 (US vendors)
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured for the pilot period (if available)
- Signed Pilot SOW (simple one-page ok)

If you can get those to me today we can request a 60-day temporary invoice-only approval and route to Finance for net-30 payment terms. This path requires an internal acknowledgment that the engagement is pilot-only and won't auto-renew unless a PO is issued.

I will loop in Finance and our Sales lead to confirm — cc'd Marissa and Laura for approvals and any sales constraints.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
(priya.natarajan@redwood.com)

Thanks Priya — I approve a temporary invoice-only route for this pilot, subject to the following operational controls (please capture in the vendor record):

1) Limit: pilot spend capped at $5,000 total; any extension requires a PO.
2) Documentation: W-9 and COI received and attached to the vendor file.
3) Agreement: BlueSigma must sign a short pilot SOW and a minimal vendor terms addendum (I can share our template).
4) Billing: Finance will process the first invoice under the temporary exception; further invoices paused until PO or new approval.

Karthik — please confirm there are no contract blockers on acceptance of the limited addendum. If Sales needs a signed commercial agreement for data or IP reasons, escalate quickly.
